steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Returning once again to the Wisteria Pavilion, the wisteria appears more luxuriant than ever—its flowering branches unfurled, coiling up the walls with an otherworldly splendor that surpasses its former glory.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Undoubtedly, this is the craft of the flower spirit, draining the life force of those she ensnares. Without a moment to spare, the outlander bursts through the gate, desperately calling out the flower spirit's name.

steps.speaker: Alluring Flower Spirit
steps.content: Right this way, esteemed guest. Would you like a cup of tea, or maybe a delightful musical interlude?

steps.speaker: Elegant Flower Spirit
steps.content: Here I am, Yinyin in the flesh. My dear sir, this is our first meeting—what brings you to call upon me?
steps.female_content: Here I am, Yinyin in the flesh. My dear lady, this is our first meeting—what brings you to call upon me?

steps.speaker: Vigorous Flower Spirit
steps.content: My my, look how worked up you are—you're sweating! Take a seat, relax, and let me help you freshen up.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I don't need that. I'm looking for—mmph!!

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Countless enchanting figures surge forward to surround the outlander, their melodious laughter more intoxicating than the sweetest floral scent. They grasp onto the outlander's garments, unwilling to release their hold.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Unfazed by their allure, the outlander firmly pushes away the ethereal beauties around, and with a stern voice and resolute bearing, declares once more:

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Don't touch me! I know what you're trying to do, and I want none of it. Let me through—I need to find someone!
I'm looking for the wisteria tree and the one who watches over its flowers!

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Yet, the commotion hushes but for a fleeting moment. The alluring figures share knowing looks, then erupt into a wave of laughter.

steps.speaker: Alluring Flower Spirit
steps.content: Oh, now I see! Another young man bewitched by Yingying's beauty!
steps.female_content: Oh, now I see! Another young lady bewitched by Yingying's beauty!

steps.speaker: Elegant Flower Spirit
steps.content: Alright, your words ring clear. Since you're so fond of Yingying, I suppose we have no other option...

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Releasing their captive, the ethereal beauties pivot away with sinister giggles, veiling their faces. When they turn back, every single one of them bears Yingying's face!

steps.speaker: Vigorous Flower Spirit
steps.content: Well, is this face to your liking, my young lord?
steps.female_content: Well, is this face to your liking, my young lady?

steps.speaker: Alluring Flower Spirit
steps.content: Yingying, a mere child... how could she rival my age-old experience? With this new guise adorning me, tell me, my young lord—between Yingying and I, who radiates greater beauty?
steps.female_content: Yingying, a mere child... how could she rival my age-old experience? With this new guise adorning me, tell me, my young lady—between Yingying and I, who radiates greater beauty?

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: The outlander freezes in shock—any attempt to struggle now futile. The enchantresses, all wearing the same beguiling face, drift forth with melodic laughter and scented breeze. Sparing him no chance to protest, they force the outlander out of the building—
steps.female_content: The outlander freezes in shock—any attempt to struggle now futile. The enchantresses, all wearing the same beguiling face, drift forth with melodic laughter and scented breeze. Sparing her no chance to protest, they force the outlander out of the building—
